characters.notes: Making progress in her training, capable of producing and controlling flame on her fingertips. Having recurring dreams about Rand and a masked man with eyes of fire.

stable_traits.personality: hot-tempered, stubborn, protective of Egwene, struggles with seasickness

aliases_observed.notes: her role in the Two Rivers
used by the Amyrlin addressing her

characters.notes: Suffers from severe seasickness. Can only channel when angry. Designated to be one of the Accepted rather than a novice. Endures harsh lesson from the Amyrlin. Appears to have strong feelings about Lan (mentioned indirectly).

stable_traits.personality: stern but sometimes cheerful, demanding teacher, strategic, believes in giving people what they deserve

characters.notes: Gives lessons personally to Egwene and Nynaeve. Demonstrates ability to create weapons from air, hold people immobile with Air, and cut someone off from the True Source. Mentions being on the water again, suggesting familiarity with sailing.

stable_traits.personality: philosophical about the Pattern and the Wheel

characters.notes: Has been teaching Egwene and knows about her dreams. Tells Egwene she will test her once they reach the White Tower. Quotes 'The Wheel weaves as the Wheel wills.'
Walks at the Amyrlin's side, carrying the flame-tipped staff.

stable_traits.physical_traits: slightly plump, high cheekbones, clear pale green tilted eyes, hair almost the color of fire

characters.notes: Meets Egwene and Nynaeve at the docks. Explains the history of Tar Valon and the nature of novice and Accepted training. Oddest-appearing woman Egwene had ever seen due to her unusual coloring.
Does not appear in the chapter but is central to Egwene's worries. She believes he is in danger based on her dreams. Egwene thinks of him as 'a man channeling' and associates him with Dragonmount.
Mentioned only in connection with Nynaeve, who snaps every time he is mentioned. Nynaeve may have been referring to him when she wanted to use a sword on someone.
Mentioned by Egwene as knowing about Rand (presumably his ability to channel) but not having said anything to other Aes Sedai.

appearances.whereabouts: On the River Queen sailing to Tar Valon, then arriving at the docks and city
appearances.notable_actions: Balances on the heeling deck, worries about Rand and her recurring dreams about him and a masked man with eyes of fire, receives a lesson from the Amyrlin Seat and successfully produces and controls flame on her fingertips, watches Tar Valon appear and marvels at the city, is met by Sheriam who will take her to the White Tower
appearances.demeanor: Worried, excited about her progress in training, awed by Tar Valon, dejected when seemingly forgotten

appearances.whereabouts: In the shared cabin on the River Queen, then arriving at Tar Valon docks
appearances.notable_actions: Suffers from seasickness, discusses Egwene's dreams with her, endures a harsh teaching session from the Amyrlin (held by Air, forced to eat something vile, lifted into the air, then has the Amyrlin thrown against the wall in retaliation before being cut off from the Source), throws pillow at door after Amyrlin leaves and rages about her treatment, arrives at Tar Valon and is met by Sheriam
appearances.demeanor: Miserable from seasickness, angry during and after the lesson, protective of Egwene, resistant to authority, determined

appearances.whereabouts: On the River Queen, in Egwene and Nynaeve's cabin giving them a lesson, then disembarking at Tar Valon
appearances.notable_actions: Visits Egwene and Nynaeve's cabin alone, gives them a lesson on channeling, demonstrates creating a sword and knife from Air, holds both women immobile with Air, lifts Nynaeve into the air, forces something vile into Nynaeve's mouth to try to provoke her anger, is thrown against the wall by Nynaeve's channeling, cuts Nynaeve off from the True Source, drops Nynaeve back onto her bed, successfully teaches Egwene to make flame dance on her fingertips, disembarks at Tar Valon to formal greeting
appearances.demeanor: Cheerful at first, then demanding and strategic as a teacher, stern when necessary, ultimately pleased with results

appearances.whereabouts: On the River Queen, then at Tar Valon docks
appearances.notable_actions: Walks at the Amyrlin's side carrying the flame-tipped staff as they disembark

appearances.whereabouts: At Tar Valon docks and the entrance to the city
appearances.notable_actions: Meets Egwene and Nynaeve at the docks after speaking with the Amyrlin, introduces herself as Mistress of Novices, explains the history of Tar Valon and the nature of training for novices and Accepted, warns both women about the difficulty ahead, gathers them up to take them to their rooms in the White Tower
appearances.demeanor: Warm, amused, confident, informative, welcoming but also stern about expectations

relationships.description: Close friends sharing a cabin; Nynaeve is protective of Egwene and Egwene tries not to upset Nynaeve
The Amyrlin teaches Egwene personally, coaxing and encouraging her progress
The Amyrlin teaches Nynaeve harshly, attempting to provoke her anger to access her power, and demonstrates dominance by cutting her off from the Source
Sheriam reports to the Amyrlin as Mistress of Novices and was sent to meet the new arrivals
Sheriam is the Mistress of Novices who will oversee Egwene's training
Sheriam has authority over Nynaeve even as one of the Accepted
Anaiya has been teaching Egwene and knows about her dreams; will test her at the White Tower
Leane serves as Keeper of the Chronicles to the Amyrlin Seat
